title: Quality is not the best, came with dust filled inside the bag
text:
Quality is not the best, came with dust filled inside the bag. I bought this bc I have boxes under my bed and wanted a underskirt to cover it.
Out of the package, the bed skirt was filled with dust. I had to bring it outside to shake out all the lint and dust on it.
The material is very light and thin.
Also another thing I noticed was the bed skirt tends to move a lot. I have a queen size bed. I placed it perfectly before putting my bed on it. After a few days. 1 side is long than the other. I personally had higher hopes.
The color was what I wanted and it was easy to setup.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Full Bed Skirt - Soft Quadruple Pleated Ruffle - Easy Fit with 16 Inch Tailored Drop - Hotel Quality, Shrinkage and Fade Resistant (Full, White)

PERFECT FIT – The long length coupled with smooth, clear appearance covers your bed perfectly, giving your room a neat and tidy look (Not suitable for beds with metal frame, foot board or posts)
